How I Work

I enjoy combining visual thinking with technical structure — building interfaces that feel modern, clear, and usable.

UI with intention

I care about layout, hierarchy, spacing, and visual clarity. Good design should not only look good — it should make things easier to understand and use.

Accessibility from the start

I want interfaces to be readable, inclusive, and usable for more people. Accessibility is something I want to keep improving in every project.

Component-based thinking

I enjoy building reusable components and structured UI systems that make products easier to scale and maintain.

Curious and fast-learning

I like exploring new tools, workflows, and technologies early, especially when they can improve how something is built or experienced.

About

I'm a fullstack-trained developer with a strong interest in frontend, UI, accessibility, and user experience. I enjoy creating digital products that feel thoughtful, modern, and easy to use.

My background includes school projects, internship work, client projects, and component-based frontend development. I've worked with UI implementation, Storybook, Figma, API integration, and both frontend and backend development.

What drives me most is the combination of creativity and structure — finding ways to turn ideas, layouts, and user needs into real products.
